name: ryu.spidercloud
description: Hosted multi-page web crawling via the Spider Cloud API (https://spider.cloud), exposed as one declarative HTTP tool. Provides the swappable `web.crawl` layer as a SECOND provider alongside the local `spider` CLI, so selecting it re-points the stable `web__crawl` tool at a hosted crawler that needs no local binary. The crawl is synchronous — `run_in_background` defaults to false and one request returns every fetched page's content, so there is no job id to poll. The canonical `depth` argument is deliberately DROPPED: Spider Cloud documents `depth: 0` as "no limit will be applied", the exact inverse of the canonical contract's "0 = the start page only". Requires a BYOK Spider Cloud API key.
